themes.name: Critical Thinking Development with Generative AI
themes.definition: Use of Generative AI tools to explicitly enhance students' ability to analyze, evaluate, and synthesize information in educational contexts
evidence: [Chen2024a] The PP-iGAI approach promoted students' critical thinking, problem-solving awareness, and learning performance.
[PelaezAyala2026] Qualitative insights revealed that the dialectical GenAI assistant promoted deeper analytical and evaluative thinking.
[Nathaniel2025] Quantitative results showed significant gains in critical thinking (conditional reasoning: t = 2.53, p = 0.018)

themes.name: Interactive AI-Powered Educational Models
themes.definition: Implementation of AI chatbots, digital agents, and interactive tools to create immersive learning experiences
evidence: [Littell2025] AI-powered chatbots interacted with students as though they were actual people in stakeholder analysis.
[Chen2024b] AI chatbot-supported approach fostered learner interaction through collaborative note-taking.
[Bora2025] AI-supported tools contributed to students' technical skills and active engagement in digital photography.

themes.name: AI Literacy and Ethical Engagement
themes.definition: Integration of AI tools requiring students to critically assess outputs, understand limitations, and address ethical implications
evidence: [Perdana2026] Students developed emerging AI literacy by critically evaluating AI output while maintaining authorial control.
[Elshall2025] Students expressed concerns about overreliance on AI tools for environmental data science.
[Sudo2025] Algorithm aversion patterns emerged in responses to feedback generated by different AI models.

themes.name: Assessment Frameworks with Generative AI
themes.definition: Development of hybrid assessment models balancing AI integration with traditional evaluation methods
evidence: [Elshall2025] FACT assessment combined Fundamental, Applied, Conceptual, and Critical Thinking elements with/without AI.
[Yuriev2025] Students critically evaluated GenAI-generated content and revised it using authoritative sources.
[Teng2026] Structural equation modeling demonstrated cognitive engagement mediating GenAI features' impact on self-efficacy.

themes.name: Metacognitive Strategy Enhancement
themes.definition: AI-driven approaches that improve learners' awareness and regulation of their cognitive processes
evidence: [Zhai2025] AI-powered applications significantly improved metacognitive strategies (η² = 0.39) in English language education.
[Jin2025] Advanced AI use for writing transformation enhanced self-regulation and critical thinking outcomes.
[Gong2025b] Progressive prompts improved students' computational thinking and algorithmic reasoning skills.

data.meta_observations: Three distinct patterns observed: 1) Progressive prompt engineering emerges as key differentiator in educational effectiveness. 2) Physical-virtual interaction blends (like eye-tracking and haptic interfaces) represent emerging research areas. 3) Multiple abstracts highlight 'augmented' rather than 'replaced' human cognition as optimal AI integration model.
data.grounding_notes: Some themes had uncertain attribution due to abstract truncation (Teng2026, Jin2025) and missing quantitative data. Quotes preserved exact wording including technical inconsistencies (e.g., 'η² = 0.39' in Zhai2025). Several studies lacked methodological details per quality notes.
